title: component_meta
description: One node in the component graph. The machine-readable layer that lets agents use the component without guessing. Edges are expressed via `relationships`. Reconciled 2026-06-18 to the authored canon: load-bearing fields (name/category/purpose/props/tokens/relationships/accessibility/antiPatterns/tokenValidation/provenance) are required and typed; `accessibility` is an open map of guidance strings (relatedSC is the typed array exception); `tokens` values may be a string or a nested object; `tokenValidation` is an open audit log; `$`-prefixed annotation keys are allowed anywhere.

tokenBinding.description: a token binding: either a prose string naming the bound token(s), or a nested group of bindings

bindsShape.description: s140-D1 (enacts s136-D1 axis A precondition): the spine token(s) a prop's visual values bind to. HYBRID shape, Dave's pick: a single token name, an array of token names, or an intent map (intent -> token name(s)). Intent vocabulary is UNRULED — an intent map is legal but its keys are open until a ratchet lane rules them. Presence is OPTIONAL at schema level (s140-D1 staging: permit now, enforce by gate later — the 'binds mandatory for visual props' clause of s136-D1 lands as a shrink-only gate, not here).

slotEntry.description: s140-D1 (enacts s136-D1 axis C): one contract-typed slot. accepts is BY TIER OR CAPABILITY ONLY — a child list has nowhere legal to go (additionalProperties:false on accepts is the mechanism). use is MANDATORY (Dave, s140-D1): every slot says why it exists.

edge.description: one typed edge in the KG parse layer (schema v2, s131-D2/s133-D1). ref is a node-id ('component:<stem>' | 'pattern:<slug>' | 'context:<slug>' | 'snippet:<filename>' | 'ruling:<sNNN-DN>') or null when unresolved without inventing a target; $note optionally carries the original prose this edge was migrated from.

purpose.description: what it is for, in English the agent can reason about

variants.description: optional — not every component has named variants

tokens.description: token bindings by intent; value is a prose string or a nested group

triggeredBy.description: elements that activate this component (e.g. a tooltip's trigger)

accessibility.description: how the component behaves for AT. An open map of named guidance strings; relatedSC is the typed array of WCAG SCs this component must satisfy.

relatedSC.description: WCAG 2.2 SCs this component must satisfy (validated by _build_integrity.py)

antiPatterns.description: explicit 'never do this' rules — the most load-bearing field. Prefix a string with REVIEW to mark it review-tier (see _CONFIDENCE.md).

tokenValidation.description: audit log of this component's tokens against the store (deprecated-token usage, rebind targets, ignored primitives). Open shape.

source.description: where the component's authority comes from. 'gap-report' = a candidate surfaced by a journey/gap report, not yet reconciled to a Figma node or code path (figma_node stays empty until a design owner binds it). 'proforma-promotion' = promoted from a reviewed _proforma artefact (near-canonical per ADR-0013 ruling 3); values are OBSERVED retrieval but remain provisional-agent until Dave's sign-off — added 2026-07-22 wave 2 for the Charts lane (conductor, unblocking worker D's C-Q4).

slots.description: s140-D1 (enacts s136-D1 axis C): contract-typed content injection. The ONLY new top-level key the three-axis model adds (s136-D1 clause C). Map of slot name -> slotEntry; OPTIONAL at schema level (staging: permit now, enforce by gate later).

motion.description: optional motion/interaction spec; per-part behaviour referencing motion/* tokens (duration, easing) + reduced-motion rule

responsive.description: optional reflow/adaptation spec (rubric Dim 11) — how the component adapts to available width: the responsive unit, breakpoint(s), stacking/full-width/reorder rules, verified down to 320px (WCAG 1.4.10). Added 2026-06-24 (Button promotion). Open shape.

dimensions.description: optional geometry/measurement spec — the sizes a generator would otherwise have to invent (height, padding, indicator/border widths, gaps, target size). Values are px numbers or strings naming a layout/spacing token. Added 2026-06-19 (fitness-test fix #3). Open shape; prefer token references over raw numbers where a token exists.

codeBindings.description: optional hub-and-spoke map of this design component to consuming code libraries. HUB = the Figma node identity (provenance.figma_node) — the only library-independent key; never renamed. Each KEY here is one consuming library (a SPOKE), e.g. 'sutherland-react'; its value records that library's own component name + variant->prop mapping, which may differ from the Figma names (different libraries, built by different humans, use different conventions). RULES: never bind logic on a friendly/display name; never normalise names across libraries (map them through the node, not to a 'winner'); populate a spoke from Code Connect (get_code_connect_map), not by guessing; tag every unverified spoke with $status. Display names live per-variant ($displayName/$aliases) and are yours, so they are stable across all libraries. Procedure to add a new library: _RUNBOOK-onboard-code-library.md. Added 2026-06-22 (Dave decision).

interactive.description: optional — false marks a PASSIVE component (no hover/active/keyboard by design; e.g. Status-indicator, Divider, Badge, Loading-indicator). The prototype-grade scorer then credits AT via role/aria-live/label rather than a keyboard handler (decided 2026-06-22, rubric option A). Default true.

stateModel.description: optional — 'simple' declares the component genuinely has only default + hover/pressed + focus (no selected/checked/disabled/expanded/current by design, e.g. Tags). The prototype-grade scorer then credits the states signal when those applicable states are implemented (:hover + :active + :focus-visible), instead of requiring >=4 enumerated selectors it can never have (Decision C, 2026-06-24). Default = full.

edges.description: schema v2 (s131-D2 RULED #131 NOT ENACTED / s133-D1 RULED #133 scope widening) — the KG parse layer: typed, resolvable node references, additive alongside `relationships`/`$consumes`/`$reuses`/etc, which stay as-is (archive-never-delete, by-addition only). Each entry is {"ref": "<node-id>"|null, "$note": "<optional original prose>"}; ref is null where the source prose could not be resolved to a node without inventing one — flagged for Dave's-eye review, never guessed. Node-id grammar: 'component:<stem>' | 'pattern:<slug>' | 'context:<slug>' | 'snippet:<filename>' | 'ruling:<sNNN-DN>'. Mechanical batch (renderedBy, consumes, reuses, hasPart, partial, family, containedBy, usedInContext, commonPattern) generated by gen_kg_edges.py; mustNotNeighbour/triggeredBy carry ref:null + prose pending Dave's-eye; governedBy is reserved for the Dave's-eye batch (ruling attributions), not yet populated.
